identity.description: Answers citation-style questions over the star-map: "most cited papers in Connectomics", "who cites <paper>?", "how connected is <paper>?". LLM-free — pure graph computation, instant and near-free. Edges are the keyword-co-occurrence proxy (the star-map’s citation graph is incomplete); every answer says so.

inputs.description: A citation-style question: "most cited papers in Connectomics", "who cites <paper title>?", "how many connections does <paper> have?"
inputs.example: Who cites the DRDCAE-STGNN motor imagery paper?

outputs.description: Citation-style answer from the star-map (proxy connections, honestly labeled)
Related papers as structured JSON (title, year, arXiv URL)

tags.name: Brain Technology
tags.description: Research on BCI, EEG decoding, neural decoding, connectomics and deep learning

tags.description: Answers questions with citations to a 215-paper arXiv corpus
